title: Design System: St Marys Village Dry Cleaners

display.purpose: Homepage hero h1 only; weight 700, word-by-word entrance, single gold emphasis word, no scene-rotation.

sectionTitle.purpose: Every .section-title sitewide; weight 500, swaps to cream via .section-title--on-dark.

body.purpose: Running copy throughout (Manrope), including .prose on legal/about pages.

label.purpose: Brand-name/brand-sub, stat-label, footer column headers, header-cta.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: .btn-primary hover; mega-menu; garment-stage; explorer-image; fabric-layer; service-detail-media; about-media.

shadows.name: shadow-dark
shadows.purpose: Fixed-call affordance and the lightbox image.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for nearly all transitions.

motion.name: reveal-on-scroll
motion.purpose: Section content fade/rise on first scroll into view (.reveal/.is-visible); collapses instantly under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: hero-word-in
motion.value: opacity 0->1, translateY(26px)->0, blur(10px)->0, 0.9s ease, staggered per-word
motion.purpose: Homepage hero h1 word-by-word entrance; no scene rotation afterward.

motion.name: hero-parallax
motion.value: translate(relX*-14px, relY*-10px) on hero mousemove, via requestAnimationFrame
motion.purpose: Subtle hero-content drift; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: garment-tilt
motion.purpose: CSS-3D tilt on garment-showcase photo, standing in for a literal 3D model (none exists in this project); disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: fabric-parallax
motion.value: translateY((scrollProgress-0.5) * 120 * layerSpeed) on scroll, via requestAnimationFrame
motion.purpose: Independent-speed scroll parallax for the three .fabric-layer images; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: call-pulse
motion.purpose: Keeps the fixed Call affordance alive; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Forest-deep-filled pill CTA used on both light and dark backgrounds.
components.css: .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em; padding: 1em 2em; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; min-height: 48px; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), box-shadow 0.35s, background-color 0.35s, border-color 0.35s, color 0.35s; } .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .btn-primary { background: #102820; color: #F5F0E6; box-shadow: 0 18px 38px -16px rgba(16,40,32,0.24); } .btn-primary:hover { background: #183B32; box-shadow: 0 32px 70px -22px rgba(16,40,32,0.32); }

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: Gold-filled pill CTA — the system's single boldest conversion action (hero, contact, final CTA).
components.css: .btn-gold { background: #B99A69; color: #102820; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px -4px rgba(16,40,32,0.14); } .btn-gold:hover { background: #8C7447; color: #F5F0E6; }

components.name: Mega Menu Preview
components.description: Sanctioned hover-to-reveal pattern: a single aria-hidden preview pane holds five opacity:0 images that swap to is-shown on link hover/focus. Not a hidden-content defect — an interactive preview affordance.
components.html: Professional Dry Cleaning
components.css: .mega-menu-preview { position: relative; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; min-height: 180px; } .mega-menu-preview img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .mega-menu-preview img.is-shown { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Garment Showcase Stage
components.description: Real photography with CSS 3D tilt (perspective/rotateX/rotateY via mousemove) and click/hover hotspots — the honest implementation of an 'interactive 3D' request given no 3D model asset exists in this project.
components.css: .garment-stage { position: relative; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 32px 70px -22px rgba(16,40,32,0.32); aspect-ratio: 4/5; } .garment-hotspot-dot { width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 50%; background: #F5F0E6; } .garment-hotspot:hover .garment-hotspot-dot { background: #B99A69; transform: scale(1.3); }

components.name: Service Explorer Tabs
components.description: Tabbed panel driving an image crossfade and text/CTA swap from data attributes on each tab button.
components.css: .explorer-tab { padding: 0.65em 1.1em; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(37,42,38,0.2); font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; } .explorer-tab.is-active { background: #102820; color: #F5F0E6; border-color: #102820; }

components.name: Why-Full Card
components.description: White card with heading + paragraph used on the dedicated Why Choose Us page — the expanded prose form of the homepage's compact stat row.
components.html:
Local By Nature, Personal By Choice

We're proud to be part of the St Marys community...
components.css: .why-full-card { padding: 2rem; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px -4px rgba(16,40,32,0.14); } .why-full-card h3 { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.3rem; color: #102820; }

components.name: FAQ Accordion Item
components.description: Real <h3><button> trigger with a CSS grid-row (0fr->1fr) open/close transition and a plus/cross pseudo-element icon.
components.html: Call ...
components.css: .accordion-panel { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr; overflow: hidden; transition: grid-template-rows 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .accordion-item.is-open .accordion-panel { grid-template-rows: 1fr; }

components.name: Contact Split Panel
components.description: 50/50 split: a dark photo-backed CTA panel beside a light card panel with hours list and a nearly-square map frame. No booking form.
components.html:
Your Garments.

components.css: .contact-split { display: flex; min-height: 620px; } .contact-intro-panel { flex: 1; background: #102820; } .contact-card-panel { flex: 1; background: #F5F0E6; } .contact-map-frame { border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 16/10; background: #D9CCB8; }

narrative.overview: This system fully replaces 'Quiet Luxury' (ivory/white/stone/charcoal/champagne, Playfair Display + Inter, a single-page 7-section stack). Quiet Luxury had itself replaced 'The Linen Press' (forest green/cream/peach/sage/coral/butter, DM Serif Display + Manrope, a 12-section hue-rotation stack) -- Atelier's forest/cream/gold palette echoes Linen Press's forest green in spirit but is an unrelated, newer build: a true multi-page architecture (directory-per-route index.html files) sharing tokens.css + layout.css, with home.css/home.js homepage-only and page.css shared across every inner page. This reintroduces a standalone FAQ accordion and a dedicated Why Choose Us page, both absent from the superseded single-page system.
keyCharacteristics: Two distinct visual registers sharing one chrome: the homepage layers scroll/pointer-driven motion over full-bleed photography, while every inner page is a flatter, calmer page-hero/page-section/prose stack -- motion is a homepage register, not sitewide
A single warm accent (gold/gold-ink) against a forest-deep dark register and a cream/white light register -- no second accent hue anywhere in the built CSS
A contextual radius split: --r-sm (4px) on smaller/flatter photography, --r-md (10px) on larger staged photography and cards, --r-pill (999px) on every button and chrome element -- never mixed

The homepage's garment-showcase 'interactive 3D' is honestly built from CSS 3D transforms on real photography via mousemove in js/home.js -- there is no GLB/GLTF asset or WebGL pipeline in this project
All JS-driven motion is gated behind prefers-reduced-motion in both CSS (tokens.css) and JS (home.js/common.js reduceMotion checks)

rules.name: The Single-Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold/gold-ink are the system's only warm color; every other surface is cream, white, beige, charcoal, or forest. There is no second accent hue.

rules.name: The Radius Split Rule
rules.body: Three radius values used by context: --r-sm (4px) on smaller/flatter photographic surfaces, --r-md (10px) on larger staged photography and cards, --r-pill (999px) on every button and chrome element. No surface mixes a pill radius onto photography or a sub-pill radius onto a button.

rules.name: The Chrome/Content Split Rule
rules.body: tokens.css + layout.css load on every page unconditionally; home.css/home.js load only on index.html; page.css loads only on inner pages -- never both home.css and page.css on the same page.

dos: Do keep homepage-only motion confined to css/home.css and js/home.js; inner pages stay in the calmer page-hero/page-section/prose register of css/page.css.
Do gate every JS-driven motion effect behind prefers-reduced-motion, matching both the CSS media query and the reduceMotion checks in js/home.js and js/common.js.
Do use --r-sm/--r-md for photographic surfaces by size/context and --r-pill only for controls and chrome (The Radius Split Rule).
Do keep all internal links and asset paths relative, never root-relative -- a dual-hosting deploy constraint from PRODUCT.md, not a style preference.
Do implement any 'interactive 3D' request as CSS 3D transforms/parallax on real photography, never as a fabricated WebGL/GLB claim.
Do keep every interactive control at a 48x48px minimum touch target.
Do use real line-art SVG icons, never a glyph/icon font.
donts: Don't carry over any token, color, or component from the superseded 'Quiet Luxury' system (ivory/stone/charcoal/champagne, Playfair Display + Inter, the single-page 7-section stack, its fixed-row-group mosaic rule, its radius-contrast rule); this is a full replacement, not a merge.
Don't add a booking/scheduling form to Contact; the business is walk-in/drive-up only (see PRODUCT.md).
Don't invent review content, star counts, pricing, or years-in-business figures; show only the sourced TrueLocal aggregate, linked out.

Don't place a kicker/eyebrow label above any heading. A reserved .eyebrow-label { display: none; } rule exists in tokens.css as a dead, never-invoked class -- this is a craft-floor ban carried forward from the prior system's review, not a component to bring back.
notCanonized: The .eyebrow-label dead CSS rule in css/tokens.css (display:none, with a comment pointing back to the ban) is inert and unused on every page scanned (home, about, services hub/detail, our-process, why-choose-us, gallery, contact, faq) -- a leftover guard rail, not a system component or available pattern for future pages.
